Climate Risk and Commercial Mortgage Delinquency
abstract: Natural disasters such as hurricanes, floods, heatwaves and wildfires are projected to become more prevalent in the foreseeable future. Climate risk is therefore increasingly recognized as an important factor by policy makers, the investment community, and financial markets. Due to the immobility of assets, the commercial real estate industry is especially vulnerable to climate risk, and there is an increasing interest to understand the impact of climate risk on the value of commercial real estate. For commercial real estate lenders, changes in collateral value are only of partial importance. The ability of borrowers to meet their payment obligations is equally, if not more important. By combining historic data on two major climate-related disasters – Hurricanes Harvey and Sandy – with longitudinal information on commercial mortgage performance, this paper identifies the impact of climate risks on mortgage delinquency rates for commercial real estate mortgages. The results show that both Harvey and Sandy led to elevated levels of commercial mortgage delinquency, with significant heterogeneity based on the extent of damage in the Census block group. Information provided through FEMA 100-year floodplain maps partially mitigates the effects, an indication that lenders incorporate flood risk information in the underwriting process.
abstract_zh: 飓风、洪水、热浪和野火等自然灾害在可预见的未来预计将变得更加普遍。因此，气候风险日益被政策制定者、投资界和金融市场视为重要因素。由于资产的不可移动性，商业地产行业尤其易受气候风险影响，人们也越来越关注气候风险对商业地产价值的影响。对于商业地产贷款机构而言，抵押品价值的变化只是部分重要，借款人履行还款义务的能力同样重要，甚至更为重要。本文通过将两次重大气候相关灾害（飓风哈维和桑迪）的历史数据与商业抵押贷款的纵向履约信息相结合，识别了气候风险对商业地产抵押贷款拖欠率的影响。结果表明，哈维和桑迪均导致商业抵押贷款拖欠水平上升，且其影响在人口普查街区组内的受损程度上存在显著异质性。联邦紧急事务管理局（FEMA）的百年一遇洪泛区地图在一定程度上减轻了这些影响，这表明贷款机构在承销过程中纳入了洪水风险信息。

title: Decarbonizing Aviation: Cash-for-Clunkers in the Airline Industry
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: The durability of the transportation capital stock slows down the pace of decarbonization since newer vintages feature cutting-edge technology. If older vintages were to be retired sooner, the social cost of travel would decline. This paper analyzes and explores the viability of a potential cash-for-clunkers program for the airline industry, which would help to hasten decarbonization of US aviation. Our estimation and calculations show that airlines can be induced to scrap rather than sell older planes upon retirement with a payment that is less than the forgone carbon damage, yielding net social benefits.
abstract_zh: 运输资本存量的耐用性减缓了脱碳的步伐，因为较新的车型采用了最尖端的技术。如果较旧的车型能够更早退役，出行的社会成本将会下降。本文分析并探讨了为航空业设计潜在的“旧车换现金”（cash-for-clunkers）计划的可行性，该计划将有助于加快美国航空业的脱碳进程。我们的估计和计算表明，只要支付的金额低于所放弃的碳损害成本，航空公司便可受到激励，在飞机退役时将旧飞机报废而非出售，从而产生净社会效益。

title: Enhancing Firm Resilience to Climate Change: A Review of Impact, Adaptation Strategies and Policy Options
abstract: This survey examines how firms in developing countries adapt to extreme and gradual changes in climate, highlighting the significant impact it has on firm performance. By integrating insights from economic geography and firm dynamics literature, the survey underscores the challenges posed by weak infrastructure, financial constraints, and firm capabilities, while also exploring the role of private and public resilience policies. Key findings reveal that firm attributes, such as size, sector, and financial access and managerial practices influence firm resilience, with larger and more productive firms showing greater adaptability. Additionally, climate‐induced uncertainties affect investment and asset valuation, particularly for smaller firms in vulnerable sectors. The survey emphasizes the importance of strategic policy interventions to support adaptive investments and mitigate climate‐related risks, noting that firms with better managerial capabilities and access to insurance are more likely to “build back better” after climate shocks.
abstract_zh: 本综述考察了发展中国家的企业如何适应极端和渐进的气候变化，并强调了其对企业绩效的重大影响。本文整合了经济地理学与企业动态文献的观点，指出薄弱的基础设施、融资约束和企业能力所带来的挑战，同时也探讨了私人和公共韧性政策的作用。主要发现表明，企业规模、行业、融资可得性以及管理实践等企业特征会影响企业韧性，规模更大、生产率更高的企业表现出更强的适应能力。此外，气候引发的不确定性会影响投资和资产估值，对于脆弱行业中的小企业而言尤为如此。本综述强调，应实施有战略意义的政策干预，以支持适应性投资并减轻气候相关风险；并指出，管理能力更强、能够获得保险的企业，在遭受气候冲击后更有可能“重建得更好”（build back better）。

title: Household Carbon Dioxide Emissions Engel Curve Dynamics
abstract: Household carbon dioxide emissions have been an increasing function of income and distance from the city. Richer suburbanites drive more and consume more electricity and natural gas at home. In recent years, richer people in California have been more likely to buy electric vehicles and to install solar panels in their homes. The electricity grid has become less carbon intensive over time. Using several California datasets, we document that these ongoing shifts in consumer behavior have flattened household transportation carbon dioxide Engel curves over the years 2018 to 2022.While household electricity emissions as a function of income have flattened, the natural gas Engel curves have not. We explore the political economy implications of the ongoing decarbonization of the private vehicle fleet. Based on voting data from California, we document that communities tend to support higher fuel taxes when their vehicle fleet is more fuel efficient.
abstract_zh: 家庭二氧化碳排放量一直是收入和距离城市远近的递增函数。收入较高的郊区居民驾驶更多车辆，在家中消耗更多电力和天然气。近年来，加州的富裕人群更有可能购买电动汽车并在家中安装太阳能板。随着时间推移，电网的碳强度不断降低。利用多个加州数据集，我们记录了这些持续进行的消费行为转变，使得2018至2022年间家庭交通二氧化碳排放的恩格尔曲线趋于平缓。尽管家庭用电排放随收入变化的曲线已趋于平缓，天然气的恩格尔曲线却并未如此。我们探讨了私家车队持续脱碳的政治经济学含义。基于加州的选举数据，我们记录到：当社区的车队燃油效率更高时，这些社区往往更支持提高燃油税。

title: How Do Airlines Cut Fuel Usage, Reducing their Carbon Emissions?
abstract: Airline fuel consumption is costly for the firms and for society as well due to a climate-change externality. We study how fuel price changes affect cost-minimizing choices by airlines that have implications for the extent of this externality. The airline industry's capital stock can be easily inventoried as a set of long-lived, durable aircraft. This portfolio approach allows us to study the utilization and composition of the capital stock at a highly disaggregated level. Changes in airline operations directed toward conserving fuel can be an important path toward lower emissions.
abstract_zh: 航空公司的燃油消耗对企业和社会而言都代价高昂，这还源于气候变化的外部性。我们研究了燃油价格变动如何影响航空公司以成本最小化为目标的选择，而这些选择关系到该外部性的程度。航空业的资本存量可以很容易地被清点为一组寿命较长的耐用飞机。这种组合方法使我们能够在高度细化的层面上研究资本存量的使用与构成。以节油为导向的航空运营调整，可以成为降低排放的重要途径。

U.S Electric Utility Adaptation to Natural Disasters Shocks and Green Power Mandates
abstract: Access to electricity is a crucial determinant of quality of life and productivity. The United States has a highly reliable electricity grid, but it faces new resilience challenges posed by more intense natural disasters and ambitious green power requirements. Using a US electric utility panel dataset from 2013 to 2020, we document that natural disasters disrupt service, but utilities have made progress in adapting to such shocks. Over the last decade, utilities have faced a tradeoff between achieving local carbon mitigation goals and offering reliable power access. We discuss alternative approaches to attenuate this tradeoff.
abstract_zh: 电力获取是决定生活质量和生产率的关键因素。美国拥有可靠性很高的电网，但它面临着因自然灾害日益加剧和雄心勃勃的绿色电力要求而带来的新挑战。利用2013至2020年美国电力公用事业面板数据，我们记录到自然灾害会中断供电，但公用事业公司在适应此类冲击方面已取得进展。在过去十年中，公用事业公司一直面临在实现地方碳减排目标与提供可靠供电之间的权衡。我们讨论了缓解这一权衡的替代方案。

title: Climate Change Adaptation: Lessons from Free to Choose
abstract: Climate change poses risks to our economic productivity and quality of life as locations face different place based risks including; extreme heat, pollution spikes, and greater natural disaster risk. Given that global carbon emissions will rise for decades, adapting to climate change becomes essential. Milton Friedman’s Price Theory approach offers many insights for understanding the microeconomics of adapting to climate change. Expectations of scarcity, human capital and price signals play a central role in guiding the decisions of optimizing economic agents. In an increasingly urbanized world economy, competition between cities and neighborhoods within cities plays a central role in determining our economic geography and thus our exposure to climate change’s physical risks. Market product competition helps us to adapt to every place based challenge we face. Firm competition to supply these products lowers their price and improves their quality. Both human capital theory and the Boskin Report’s logic optimistically predicts that poor people will increasingly gain from an increased capacity to protect themselves from emerging risks. In areas that fail to adapt, hedonic real estate prices will adjust to compensate those who choose to take on more location specific risk. The logic of Friedman’s Free to Choose offers many testable empirical implications focused on how we will successfully adapt to the serious climate change challenge.
abstract_zh: 气候变化给经济生产率和生活质量带来了风险，因为各地面临着不同的基于地点的风险，包括极端高温、污染骤增以及更大的自然灾害风险。鉴于全球碳排放在未来数十年仍将上升，适应气候变化变得至关重要。米尔顿·弗里德曼的价格理论方法为理解适应气候变化的微观经济学提供了许多洞见。对稀缺性的预期、人力资本和价格信号在指导经济主体优化决策方面发挥着核心作用。在日益城市化的世界经济中，城市之间以及城市内部街区之间的竞争，在决定我们的经济地理格局、从而决定我们面临气候变化物理风险的程度方面起着核心作用。市场上的产品竞争帮助我们应对所面临的每一项基于地点的挑战。供应这些产品的企业之间的竞争降低了价格，并提高了质量。人力资本理论和博斯金报告（Boskin Report）的逻辑都乐观地预测，贫困人口将越来越多地受益于其保护自身免受新兴风险的能力的提升。在无法适应的地区，房地产的享乐价格将作出调整，以补偿那些选择承担更多特定地点风险的人。弗里德曼《自由选择》（Free to Choose）的逻辑为我们如何成功应对严峻的气候变化挑战，提供了许多可检验的实证推论。

title: Geographic Disparities in Quality of Life in 21st-Century America
Do Red States Have a Comparative Advantage in Generating Green Power?
venue: Environmental and Energy Policy and the Economy (NBER)
abstract: The passage of the 2022 Inflation Reduction Act will lead to a significant increase in US wind and solar power investment. Renewable power generation requires more land than fossil fuel fired power generation. The land that will be allocated to renewables depends on several demand-side and supply-side factors such as the land’s renewable power potential, cost of acquisition, proximity to final power consumers, and local land use regulations. We find that Republican areas are more likely to issue interconnection permits than progressive areas. We present evidence that rural Republican areas have a cost advantage in generating wind power; however, Democratic areas have sited more solar capacity. We use our statistical model to identify Republican congressional districts that have the potential to scale up green power production.
abstract_zh: 2022年《通胀削减法案》的通过将使美国风电和太阳能投资显著增加。可再生能源发电所需的土地比化石燃料发电更多。分配给可再生能源的土地取决于若干需求侧和供给侧因素，例如土地的可再生能源潜力、获取成本、与最终电力用户的距离以及当地土地利用监管。我们发现，共和党地区比进步派地区更可能获得并网许可。我们提供的证据表明，农村共和党地区在风电生产方面具有成本优势；然而，民主党地区则布局了更多的太阳能装机容量。我们利用统计模型识别出那些有潜力扩大绿色电力生产的共和党国会选区。

title: A New Spatial Hedonic Equilibrium in the Emerging Work from Home Economy?
Local Public Finance Dynamics and Hurricane Strikes
Clean Air as an Experience Good in Urban China
Does Pollution Hinder Urban Competitiveness?
abstract: This paper surveys the recent literature exploring the causes of urban pollution in the developing world and the implications of such pollution for a city's competitiveness. Within a system of cities, cities compete for jobs and people. Those cities that specialize in heavy industrial activity will gain from a manufacturing boom but are more likely to be polluted than a city that specializes in the service economy and one that makes investments in regulations to reduce the social costs of power generation, transportation, and household services. The paper explores three main questions. First, why does pollution inhibit urban competitiveness? Second, why is this effect likely to grow in importance over time? Third, why have cities been slow to adopt cost-effective regulatory strategies?
abstract_zh: 本文综述了近期探讨发展中国家城市污染成因及其对城市竞争力影响的文献。在城市体系中，城市之间为争夺就业和人口而相互竞争。那些专注于重工业活动的城市，将在制造业繁荣中获益，但与专注于服务经济、且投资于监管以降低电力生产、交通运输和家庭服务社会成本的城市相比，前者更可能受到污染。本文探讨三个主要问题。第一，为什么污染会抑制城市竞争力？第二，为什么这一效应可能随时间推移而日益重要？第三，为什么城市在采用具有成本效益的监管策略方面一直进展缓慢？

title: Ghost Cities" versus Boom Towns: When Do China's HSR New Towns Thrive?
Housing Supply and Local Political Influence
Long-Term Macroeconomic Effects of Climate Change: A Cross-Country Analysis
abstract: We study the long-term impact of climate change on economic activity across countries, using a stochastic growth model where labor productivity is affected by country-specific climate variables—defined as deviations of temperature and precipitation from their historical norms. Using a panel data set of 174 countries over the years 1960 to 2014, we find that per-capita real output growth is adversely affected by persistent changes in the temperature above or below its historical norm, but we do not obtain any statistically significant effects for changes in precipitation. Our counterfactual analysis suggests that a persistent increase in average global temperature by 0.04°C per year, in the absence of mitigation policies, reduces world real GDP per capita by more than 7 percent by 2100. On the other hand, abiding by the Paris Agreement, thereby limiting the temperature increase to 0.01°C per annum, reduces the loss substantially to about 1 percent. These effects vary significantly across countries depending on the pace of temperature increases and variability of climate conditions. We also provide supplementary evidence using data on a sample of 48 U.S. states between 1963 and 2016, and show that climate change has a long-lasting adverse impact on real output in various states and economic sectors, and on labor productivity and employment.
abstract_zh: 我们使用一个随机增长模型，研究气候变化对各国经济活动的长期影响。在该模型中，劳动生产率受国家层面气候变量的影响，这些变量被定义为气温和降水量相对其历史常态的偏离。利用1960至2014年间174个国家的面板数据，我们发现人均实际产出增长会受到气温相对其历史常态的持续性变化的不利影响，无论是高于还是低于常态；但降水变化的影响在统计上并不显著。我们的反事实分析表明，在没有减缓政策的情况下，全球平均气温每年持续上升0.04°C，到2100年将使世界人均实际GDP减少7%以上。另一方面，若遵守《巴黎协定》，将气温升幅限制在每年0.01°C，则损失可大幅降至约1%。这些效应在各国之间存在显著差异，取决于气温上升的速度和气候条件的变异程度。我们还利用1963至2016年间48个美国州的数据提供了补充证据，表明气候变化对各州及各经济部门的实际产出、劳动生产率和就业具有长期的不利影响。

title: The Urban Crime and Heat Gradient in Low and High Poverty Areas
abstract: We use spatially disaggregated daily crime data for the City of Los Angeles to measure the impact of heat and pollution on crime and to study how this relationship varies across the city. On average, overall crime increases by 2.2% and violent crime by 5.7% on days with maximum daily temperatures above 85 degrees Fahrenheit (29.4°C) compared to days below that threshold. The heat-crime relationship is more pronounced in low-income neighborhoods. This suggests that heat shocks can increase spatial urban quality of life differences through their effect on crime. We use other administrative data and find some evidence that policing intensity declines on extremely hot days. These findings highlight that the quality of urban governance during times of extreme stress may be an important policy lever in helping all socio-economic groups adapt to climate change.
abstract_zh: 我们利用洛杉矶市按空间细分的日度犯罪数据，衡量高温和污染对犯罪的影响，并考察这一关系在城市内部如何变化。平均而言，与日最高气温低于华氏85度（29.4°C）的日子相比，当日最高气温超过该阈值时，总体犯罪率上升2.2%，暴力犯罪率上升5.7%。高温与犯罪之间的关系在低收入社区更为显著。这表明，热冲击可能通过影响犯罪而扩大城市生活质量的空间差异。我们利用其他行政数据发现，有一些证据表明，在极端炎热的日子里，警务强度会下降。这些发现表明，在极端压力时期，城市治理的质量可能是帮助所有社会经济群体适应气候变化的重要政策杠杆。

title: Do Political Connections Help or Hinder Urban Economic Growth? Evidence from the Opening of 1,400 Industrial Parks in China
The Effect of Natural Disasters on Economic Activity in US Counties: A Century of Data
abstract: More than 100 natural disasters strike the United States every year, causing extensive fatalities and damages. We construct the universe of US federally designated natural disasters from 1920 to 2010.We find that severe disasters increase out-migration rates at the county level by 1.5 percentage points and lower housing prices/rents by 2.5-5.0 percent. The migration response to milder disasters is smaller but has been increasing over time. The economic response to disasters is most consistent with falling local productivity and labor demand. Disasters that convey more information about future disaster risk increase the pace of out-migration.
abstract_zh: 美国每年发生100多起自然灾害，造成大量人员伤亡和财产损失。我们构建了1920至2010年间美国联邦政府认定的全部自然灾害数据集。我们发现，严重灾害使县级迁出率上升1.5个百分点，并使房价/租金下降2.5%至5.0%。对较轻灾害的迁移反应较小，但随时间推移而不断增强。灾害的经济反应与当地生产率下降和劳动需求减少最为一致。那些能够传递更多未来灾害风险信息的灾害，会加快迁出的速度。

title: Air Pollution Lowers Chinese Urbanites Expressed Happiness on Social Media
Air Pollution Lowers High Skill Public Sector Worker Productivity in China
abstract: China’s urbanites continue to be exposed to high levels of air pollution. Such pollution exposure raises mortality risk, lowers the day-to-day sentiment of the population and lowers outdoor worker productivity. Using a unique set of data for Chinese judges, we document that local air pollution also lowers the productivity of high skilled government officials who work indoors. Our new evidence on the effects of air pollution highlights both the challenge that pollution poses for quality of life and workforce productivity and indicates that the Chinese urban elites gain co-benefits when their cities burn less fossil fuel.
abstract_zh: 中国城市居民仍然暴露在高水平的空气污染之中。这种污染暴露会提高死亡风险，降低民众的日常情绪，并降低户外工作者的生产率。利用中国法官的一组独特数据，我们发现，当地空气污染同样会降低在室内工作的高技能政府官员的生产率。我们关于空气污染影响的新证据既凸显了污染对生活质量和劳动生产率构成的挑战，也表明，当城市减少化石燃料燃烧时，中国城市精英将获得附带收益。

title: Does Clean Air Increase the Demand for the Consumer City? Evidence from Beijing
Impact of Voluntary Green Certification on Building Energy Performance
Prolonging Coal's Sunset: The Causes and Consequences of Local Protectionism for a Declining Polluting Industry
abstract: In recent years, the share of U.S electricity generated by coal has fallen from nearly 50% to 33%.The costs of this transition are spatially concentrated, and mining states have already lost income due to the reduced demand for coal. Coal states have enacted policies to encourage local power plants to purchase from within state mines. We document that power plants in states and counties with substantial mining activity are more likely to be coal fired and to purchase more within political boundary coal. These results are robust to including flexible controls for the distance from power plants to mines. While coal states benefits from local protectionism, these efforts impose social costs because coal mining and coal burning creates significant environmental consequences. We quantify these effects and find that a one-percentage point increase in the proportion of coal plants in a NERC region with an in-state coal mine results in approximately 2.3 million additional annual tons of CO2 emissions.
abstract_zh: 近年来，美国燃煤发电量的占比已从近50%下降至33%。这一转型的成本在空间上高度集中，采煤州已因煤炭需求减少而损失了收入。煤炭州已出台政策，鼓励本地发电厂优先购买州内煤矿的煤炭。我们发现，采矿活动规模较大的州和县，其发电厂更可能以煤炭为燃料，并且购买的政治边界内煤炭也更多。在纳入发电厂至煤矿距离的灵活控制变量后，这些结果依然稳健。尽管煤炭州从地方保护主义中获益，但这些努力也带来了社会成本，因为煤炭开采和燃烧会产生重大的环境后果。我们量化了这些效应，发现在一个NERC区域内，若州内有煤矿的燃煤电厂占比每上升一个百分点，每年将额外产生约230万吨CO2排放。

title: The Critical Role of Markets in Adapting to Climate Change

A New Era of Pollution Progress in Urban China?
abstract: Over the last 30 years, China's economy has boomed. This trend has lifted hundreds of millions of Chinese out of poverty but it has also sharply increased local, regional, and global pollution levels. We look at the rise in air pollution over recent decades, and the perhaps surprising finding that in many of China's urban areas, levels of particulates (of less than 10 microns) have been decreasing during the last 10 to 15 years. We then turn to the costs and tradeoffs of air pollution, including costs to human health, reductions in worker productivity, and how people are seeking to reduce their exposure to pollution as shown by compensating differentials in real estate prices and purchases of masks and air filters. We discuss how rising incomes tend to raise the demand for environmental amenities and thus increase political pressure for environmental protection, and then we turn to the policy tools that China has used to reduce pollution. We conclude by arguing that as China's government is preparing for an additional 300 million people to move to urban areas over the next 30 years, it will have a number of opportunities for China to reduce pollution through a shift from manufacturing to services, along with various steps to improve energy efficiency and resource conservation. Overall, it seems that China is on track to improve its environmental performance in the years ahead.
abstract_zh: 过去30年间，中国经济蓬勃发展。这一趋势使数亿中国人摆脱了贫困，但也使地方、区域和全球的污染水平急剧上升。我们考察了近几十年空气污染的上升，并发现一个或许出人意料的结论：在中国的许多城市地区，粒径小于10微米的颗粒物水平在过去10至15年间一直在下降。随后，我们讨论了空气污染的成本与权衡，包括对人体健康的危害、对劳动生产率的削减，以及人们如何设法减少污染暴露，这体现在房地产价格中的补偿性差异以及口罩和空气过滤器的购买上。我们讨论了收入上升如何往往提高对环境舒适性的需求，从而增加环境保护的政治压力，随后考察了中国为减少污染所采用的政策工具。最后，我们认为，随着中国政府准备在未来30年内迎接另外3亿人口迁入城市，中国将有若干机会通过从制造业向服务业转型，以及采取各种提高能源效率和资源节约的措施来减少污染。总体而言，中国似乎正步入在未来几年改善环境表现的正确轨道。

Will Climate Change Cause Enormous Social Costs for Poor Asian Cities?
abstract: Climate change could significantly reduce the quality of life for poor people in Asia. Extreme heat and drought, and the increased incidence of natural disasters will pose new challenges for the urban poor and rural farmers. If farming profits decline, urbanization rates will accelerate and the social costs of rapid urbanization could increase due to rising infectious disease rates, pollution, and congestion. This paper studies strategies for reducing the increased social costs imposed on cities by climate change.
abstract_zh: 气候变化可能显著降低亚洲贫困人口的生活质量。极端高温和干旱，以及自然灾害发生率的上升，将给城市贫困人口和农村农民带来新的挑战。如果农业利润下降，城市化速度将加快，而快速城市化的社会成本可能因传染病发病率、污染和拥堵的上升而增加。本文研究了降低气候变化给城市带来的额外社会成本的策略。

title: Cities and the Environment
venue: Handbook of Regional and Urban Economics
abstract: This paper surveys recent literature examining the relationship between environmental amenities and urban growth. In this survey, we focus on the role of both exogenous attributes such as climate and coastal access as well as endogenous attributes such as local air pollution and green space.A city's greenness is a function of both its natural beauty and is an emergent property of the types of households and firms that locate within its borders and the types of local and national regulations enacted by voters.¸We explore four main issues related to sustainability and environmental quality in cities. First, we introduce a household locational choice model to highlight the role that environmental amenities play in shaping where households locate within a city. We then analyze how ongoing suburbanization affects the carbon footprint of cities. Third, we explore how the system of cities is affected by urban environmental amenity dynamics and we explore the causes of these dynamics. Fourth, we review the recent literature on the private costs and benefits of investing in "green" buildings. Throughout this survey, we pay careful attention to empirical research approaches and highlight what are open research questions. While much of the literature focuses on cities in the developed world, we anticipate that similar issues will be of increased interest in developing nation's cities.
abstract_zh: 本文综述了近期考察环境舒适性与城市增长之间关系的文献。在本综述中，我们关注外生属性（如气候和沿海可达性）以及内生属性（如当地空气污染和绿地）的作用。城市的绿色程度既取决于其自然风光，也是迁入其境内的家庭和企业类型以及选民所通过的地方和国家法规共同作用的结果。我们探讨了与城市可持续性和环境质量相关的四个主要问题。第一，我们引入一个家庭区位选择模型，以阐明环境舒适性在塑造家庭在城市内部定居地点方面所起的作用。随后，我们分析了持续进行的郊区化如何影响城市的碳足迹。第三，我们探讨城市环境舒适性动态如何影响城市体系，并探究这些动态的成因。第四，我们回顾了关于投资“绿色”建筑的私人成本与收益的最新文献。在整个综述中，我们高度关注实证研究方法，并指出了有待解决的开放性研究问题。尽管大部分文献关注发达国家的城市，但我们预计，类似问题也将在发展中国家的城市中受到越来越多的关注。

title: Climate Change Adaptation: Lessons from Urban Economics
abstract: In an urbanizing world economy featuring thousands of cities, households and firms have strong incentives to make locational investments and self protection choices to reduce their exposure to new climate change induced risks. This pursuit of self interest reduces the costs imposed by climate change. This paper develops a dynamic compensating differentials model to explore how the "menu" offered by a system of cities insures us against emerging risks. Insights from urban economics offer a series of testable hypotheses concerning the economic incidence of spatially tied climate change risk.
abstract_zh: 在一个拥有数千座城市的城市化世界经济中，家庭和企业有强烈的动机进行区位投资并采取自我保护的选择，以减少其暴露于新出现的、由气候变化引发的风险之中。这种对自身利益的追求降低了气候变化所施加的成本。本文构建了一个动态补偿性差异模型，以探讨城市体系所提供的“菜单”如何为我们提供应对新兴风险的保险。城市经济学的洞见提出了一系列关于空间固定的气候变化风险的经济归宿（economic incidence）的可检验假说。

title: Congressional Influence as a Determinant of Subprime Lending
Household Carbon Emissions from Transportation and Center City Quality of Life
Household Demand for Low Carbon Public Policies: Evidence from California
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: In recent years, Californians have voted on two key pieces of low carbon regulation. The resulting voting patterns provide an opportunity to examine the demand for carbon mitigation efforts. Household voting patterns are found to mirror the voting patterns by the U.S Congress on national carbon legislation. Political liberals and more educated voters favor such regulations while suburbanites tend to oppose such initiatives. Survey responses at the individual level are shown to predict the spatial variation in actual voting patterns and hence convergent validity for results obtained with stated preference data on voting markets.
abstract_zh: 近年来，加州民众就两项关键的低碳监管措施进行了投票。由此产生的投票模式为考察民众对碳减排努力的需求提供了契机。研究发现，家庭投票模式与美国国会在全国性碳排放立法上的投票模式相似。政治上的自由派和受教育程度较高的选民支持此类监管，而郊区居民则倾向于反对此类举措。个体层面的调查回答能够预测实际投票模式的空间差异，因此，基于陈述偏好数据在投票市场中获得的结果具有收敛效度（convergent validity）。

title: Investor Confidence as a Determinant of China's Urban Housing Market Dynamics
Public Transit Bus Procurement: The Role of Energy Prices, Regulation and Federal Subsidies
abstract: The U.S. public transit system represents a multi-billion dollar industry that provides essential transit services to millions of urban residents. We study the market for new transit buses that features a set of non-profit transit agencies purchasing buses primarily from a few domestic bus makers. Unlike private vehicles, the fuel economy of public buses is irresponsive to fuel price changes. To understand this finding, we build a model of bus fleet management decisions of local transit agencies that yields testable hypotheses. Our empirical analysis of bus fleet turnover and capital investment suggests that transit agencies: (1) do not respond to energy prices in either their scrappage or purchase decisions;(2) respond to environmental regulations by scrapping diesel buses earlier and switch to natural gas buses; (3) prefer purchasing buses from manufacturers whose assembly plants are located in the same state; (4) exhibit significant brand loyalty or lock-in effects; (5) favor domestically produced buses when they have access to more federal funding.
abstract_zh: 美国公共交通系统是一个价值数十亿美元的产业，为数百万城市居民提供基本的交通服务。我们研究新型公交车市场，该市场中的非营利性公交机构主要向少数几家国内公交车制造商采购车辆。与私家车不同，公交车的燃油经济性对燃油价格变化并不敏感。为理解这一发现，我们构建了一个地方公交机构车队管理决策模型，并由此推导出可检验的假说。我们对公交车队更新与资本投资的实证分析表明，公交机构：(1)在报废或购置决策上均不对能源价格作出反应；(2)对环境法规作出反应，即提前报废柴油公交车并转向天然气公交车；(3)倾向于从装配厂位于同一州的制造商处购买公交车；(4)表现出显著的品牌忠诚度或锁定效应；(5)当获得更多联邦资金时，更偏好购买国产公交车。

title: Utilizing "Big Data" to Improve the Hotel Sector's Energy Efficiency: Lessons from Recent Economics Research
abstract: Hotel chains have access to a treasure trove of “big data” on individual hotels’ monthly electricity and water consumption. Benchmarked comparisons of hotels within a specific chain create the opportunity to cost-effectively improve the environmental performance of specific hotels. This paper describes a simple approach for using such data to achieve the joint goals of reducing operating expenditure and achieving broad sustainability goals. In recent years, energy economists have used such “big data” to generate insights about the energy consumption of the residential, commercial, and industrial sectors. Lessons from these studies are directly applicable for the hotel sector. A hotel’s administrative data provide a “laboratory” for conducting random control trials to establish what works in enhancing hotel energy efficiency.
abstract_zh: 酒店连锁集团掌握着大量关于各家酒店每月电力和用水量的“大数据”。对某一连锁集团内部酒店进行基准比较，为以成本效益高的方式改善特定酒店的环境绩效创造了机会。本文介绍了一种简便方法，用以利用此类数据同时实现降低运营支出和达成广泛可持续发展目标的双重目标。近年来，能源经济学家利用此类“大数据”来洞察居民、商业和工业部门的能源消费情况。这些研究的经验可直接应用于酒店行业。酒店的管理数据提供了一个“实验室”，可用于开展随机对照试验，以确定何种方法能有效提高酒店的能源效率。

title: Water Pollution Progress at Borders: The Role of Changes in China's Political Promotion Incentives
abstract: At political boundaries, local leaders have weak incentives to reduce polluting activity because the social costs are borne by downstream neighbors. This paper exploits a natural experiment set in China in which the central government changed the local political promotion criteria and thus incentivized local officials to reduce border pollution along specific criteria. We document evidence of pollution progress with respect to targeted criteria at province boundaries. Heavy metal pollutants, not targeted by the central government, have not decreased in concentration after the regime shift. Using data on the economic geography of key industrial water polluters, we explore possible mechanisms. (JEL D72, O13, O18, P25, P28, Q25, Q53)
abstract_zh: 在政治边界处，地方领导人减少污染活动的激励较弱，因为社会成本由下游邻近地区承担。本文利用中国的一项自然实验，在该实验中，中央政府改变了地方政治晋升标准，从而激励地方官员沿特定标准减少边界污染。我们记录了各省边界处针对目标标准的污染改善证据。未被中央政府列为目标的重金属污染物，在政权转变后其浓度并未下降。利用关键工业水污染源的经济地理数据，我们探讨了可能的作用机制。（JEL D72, O13, O18, P25, P28, Q25, Q53）

title: The Capitalization of Green Labels in the California Residential Housing Market
The Evolving Geography of China's Industrial Production: Implications for Pollution Dynamics and Urban Quality of Life
abstract: China's rapid economic growth has been fueled by industrialization and urbanization. Given its export focus, this industrialization was spatially concentrated in the coastal eastern cities. Over the last decade, a spatial transformation has taken place leading to a deindustrialization of the rich coastal cities and sharp industrial growth in the inland cities. This survey examines recent work that studies the economic geography of industrial production, per-capita income, pollution and quality of life in China's cities. We focus on the interaction between firms, local governments and the central government that together determine the new economic geography of industry and pollution within China.
abstract_zh: 中国的快速经济增长以工业化和城市化为动力。由于以出口为导向，这一工业化在空间上集中于东部沿海城市。在过去十年中，发生了空间上的转型，导致富裕沿海城市去工业化，而内陆城市工业则迅速增长。本综述考察了近期关于中国城市工业生产、人均收入、污染与生活质量的经济地理学研究。我们关注企业、地方政府与中央政府之间的相互作用，正是这些相互作用共同决定了中国工业与污染的新经济地理格局。

title: Carbon Geography: The Political Economy of Congressional Support for Legislation Intended to Mitigate Greenhouse Gas Production
abstract: Stringent regulation for mitigating greenhouse gas emissions will impose different costs across geographical regions. Low-carbon, environmentalist states, such as California, would bear less of the incidence of such regulation than high-carbon Midwestern states. Such anticipated costs are likely to influence Congressional voting patterns. This paper uses several geographical data sets to document that conservative, poor areas have higher per-capita carbon emissions than liberal, richer areas. Representatives from such areas are shown to have much lower probabilities of voting in favor of anti-carbon legislation. In the 111th Congress, the Energy and Commerce Committee consists of members who represent high carbon districts. These geographical facts suggest that the Obama Administration and the Waxman Committee will face distributional challenges in building a majority voting coalition in favor of internalizing the carbon externality.
abstract_zh: 严格的温室气体减排监管将在不同地理区域带来不同的成本。低碳、环保型的州（如加州）相比高碳的中西部各州，承担的此类监管成本份额更小。这种预期成本很可能会影响国会的投票模式。本文利用多个地理数据集，记录了保守派、贫穷地区的人均碳排放高于自由派、富裕地区。来自这些地区的众议员投票支持反碳立法的概率则低得多。在第111届国会中，能源与商务委员会的成员代表的是高碳选区。这些地理事实表明，奥巴马政府和沃克斯曼委员会在组建支持将碳外部性内部化的多数投票联盟时，将面临分配性挑战。

venue: Journal of the European Economic Association
abstract: Nudges" are being widely promoted to encourage energy conservation. We show that the popular electricity conservation "nudge" of providing feedback to households on own and peers' home electricity usage in a home electricity report is two to four times more effective with political liberals than with conservatives. Political conservatives are more likely than liberals to opt out of receiving the home electricity report and to report disliking the report. Our results suggest that energy conservation nudges need to be targeted to be most effective.
abstract_zh: “助推”（nudges）正被广泛推行以鼓励节约能源。我们发现，在家庭电力报告中向家庭提供关于自家及同伴家庭用电情况的反馈，这一广受推崇的电力节约“助推”手段，对政治自由派的有效性是对保守派的两至四倍。保守派比自由派更可能选择退出接收家庭电力报告，并更可能表示不喜欢该报告。我们的结果表明，能源节约助推需要有针对性地实施，才能达到最佳效果。

title: Understanding China's Urban Pollution Dynamics
abstract: China's ongoing urban economic growth has sharply increased the population's per capita income, lowered the count of people living below the poverty line, and caused major environmental problems. We survey the growing literature investigating the causes and consequences of China's urban pollution challenges. We begin by studying how urban population and industrial growth impacts local pollution levels and greenhouse gas production. As the urban population grows richer, its demand for private transportation and electricity sharply increases. Such privately beneficial activity exacerbates urban pollution externalities. Facing these severe environmental challenges, China's urbanites increasingly demand quality of life progress. We survey the emerging literature investigating the demand for environmental progress in China. Progress in mitigating externalities hinges on whether the powerful central and local governments choose to address these issues. We analyze the political economy of whether government officials have strong incentives to tackle lingering urban externalities. We conclude by discussing future research opportunities at the intersection of environmental and urban economics. (JEL O18, P25, P28, Q53, R23, R41, R58)
abstract_zh: 中国持续的城市经济增长大幅提高了人均收入，减少了生活在贫困线以下的人口，但也带来了重大的环境问题。我们综述了日益增多的、考察中国城市污染挑战的成因与后果的文献。我们首先研究城市人口和工业增长如何影响地方污染水平与温室气体排放。随着城市人口日益富裕，其对私家交通和电力的需求急剧增加。这种对私人有利的活动加剧了城市污染的外部性。面对这些严峻的环境挑战，中国城市居民对生活质量改善的需求日益增长。我们综述了新近出现的、考察中国环境改善需求的文献。减缓外部性的进展取决于强大的中央和地方政府是否选择应对这些问题。我们分析了政府官员是否有强烈动机去解决长期存在的城市外部性问题的政治经济学。最后，我们讨论了环境经济学与城市经济学交叉领域未来的研究机会。（JEL O18, P25, P28, Q53, R23, R41, R58）

title: Cities, Economic Development and the Role of Place Based Policies: Prospects for Appalachia
The Nascent Market for "Green" Real Estate in China
Understanding Cross-National Trends in High Tech Renewable Power Generation Equipment Exports to the United States
abstract: We track US imports of advanced technology wind and solar power-generation equipment from a panel of countries during 1989-2010, and examine the determining factors including sector-specific US FDI outflow, country size, and domestic wind and solar power generation. Differentiating between the core high-tech and the balance of system equipment, we find US imports of the both categories have grown at significantly higher rate from the relatively poorer countries, particularly China and India.US FDI is found to play a significant positive role in the exports of high-tech equipment from both rich and poor countries, especially for the balance of system equipment. For the core wind and solar equipment, we find domestic renewable power generation played a significant positive role, and the effect is more pronounced for the rich countries as well as China compared to other poor countries.
abstract_zh: 我们追踪了1989至2010年间美国从一组国家进口先进技术风力和太阳能发电设备的情况，并考察了决定进口的因素，包括特定行业的美国对外直接投资（FDI）流出、国家规模以及国内风能和太阳能发电量。我们区分了核心高技术设备与系统平衡（BOS）设备两类，发现美国从相对贫穷的国家进口这两类设备的增长速度均显著更快，尤其是来自中国和印度。美国对外直接投资对富国和穷国的高技术设备出口均具有显著的正向作用，对系统平衡设备而言尤为明显。对于核心风能和太阳能设备，我们发现国内可再生能源发电发挥了显著的正向作用，且与其他贫穷国家相比，这一效应在富国以及中国更为突出。

title: Understanding the Solar Home Price Premium: Electricity Generation and "Green" Social Status
abstract: This study uses a large sample of homes in the San Diego area and Sacramento, California area to provide some of the first capitalization estimates of the sales value of homes with solar panels relative to comparable homes without solar panels. Although the residential solar home market continues to grow, there is little direct evidence on the market capitalization effect. Using both hedonics and a repeat sales index approach we find that solar panels are capitalized at roughly a 3.5% premium. This premium is larger in communities with a greater share of college graduates and of registered Prius hybrid vehicles.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用加利福尼亚州圣地亚哥地区和萨克拉门托地区的大量住房样本，首次对安装太阳能板的住宅相对于可比的未安装住宅的销售价值资本化效应进行了估计。尽管住宅太阳能市场持续增长，但关于其市场资本化效应的直接证据却很少。运用特征价格法（hedonics）和重复销售指数方法，我们发现太阳能板的资本化溢价约为3.5%。在大学毕业生比例更高、以及注册普锐斯混合动力汽车数量更多的社区，这一溢价更大。

title: Urban Policy Effects on Carbon Mitigation
venue: The Design and Implementation of U.S. Climate Policy
abstract: The geographical location of economic activity within the United States has important implications for carbon mitigation. If households clustered in California's cities rather than in more humid southern cities such as Memphis and Houston, then the average household carbon footprint would be lower. Such households would consume less electricity and this power would be generated by cleaner electric utilities. Within metropolitan areas, urban economic theory predicts that households create less greenhouse gas emissions when they live closer to the city center. This study uses three data sets reporting on household driving, public transit use and residential electricity consumption to provide evidence in support of the claim of a negative association between center city living and a household's carbon footprint.
abstract_zh: 美国境内经济活动的地理位置对碳减排具有重要意义。如果家庭集中居住在加州的城市，而非南部更为潮湿的城市（如孟菲斯和休斯敦），那么家庭的平均碳足迹将会更低。这些家庭的用电量会更少，且这些电力将由更清洁的电力公司生产。在大都市区内，城市经济理论预测，家庭居住得离市中心越近，其产生的温室气体排放就越少。本研究利用三组数据集（分别记录家庭驾车、公共交通使用以及住宅用电情况），为市中心居住与家庭碳足迹之间存在负相关关系这一论断提供了证据。

title: Concern About Climate Change and the Business Cycle: The Chilling Effects of Recessions
Do Liberal Cities Discourage New Housing Development?
China's Green Cities: Household Carbon Emissions and Urban Development
Economic Conditions Predict Prevalence of West Nile Virus
Health, Stress and Social Networks: Evidence from Civil War Veterans
International Trade in Used Vehicles: The Environmental Consequences of NAFTA
abstract: Since trade restrictions were eliminated in 2005, Mexico has imported over 2.5 million used vehicles from the United States. Using a unique, vehicle-level dataset, we find that traded vehicles are dirtier than the stock of vehicles in the United States and cleaner than the stock in Mexico, so when a vehicle is traded from the United States to Mexico average vehicle emissions per mile tend to decrease in both countries. Overall, however, the evidence suggests that trade has increased total lifetime emissions, primarily because of low vehicle retirement rates in Mexico. (JEL F13, F14, L62, O13, O19, Q53, Q56)
abstract_zh: 自2005年取消贸易限制以来，墨西哥已从美国进口了超过250万辆二手车。利用独特的车辆层面数据，我们发现，跨境交易的车辆比美国车辆存量更脏，但比墨西哥车辆存量更干净，因此当车辆从美国转移到墨西哥时，两国的每英里平均车辆排放往往都会下降。然而，总体而言，证据表明贸易增加了车辆的终生排放总量，主要原因是墨西哥的车辆报废率较低。（JEL F13, F14, L62, O13, O19, Q53, Q56）

title: New Evidence on Trends in the Cost of Urban Agglomeration
The Greenness of Cities: Carbon Dioxide Emissions and Urban Development
abstract: Carbon dioxide emissions may create significant social harm because of global warming, yet American urban development tends to be in low density areas with very hot summers. In this paper, we attempt to quantify the carbon dioxide emissions associated with new construction in different locations across the country. We look at emissions from driving, public transit, home heating, and household electricity usage. We find that the lowest emissions areas are generally in California and that the highest emissions areas are in Texas and Oklahoma. There is a strong negative association between emissions and land use regulations. By restricting new development, the cleanest areas of the country would seem to be pushing new development towards places with higher emissions. Cities generally have significantly lower emissions than suburban areas, and the city-suburb gap is particularly large in older areas, like New York.
abstract_zh: 二氧化碳排放可能因全球变暖而造成重大社会危害，然而美国的城市发展往往集中在夏季极为炎热的低密度地区。本文尝试量化美国各地新建住房所产生的二氧化碳排放。我们考察了驾车、公共交通、家庭供暖和家庭用电所产生的排放。我们发现，排放最低的地区大多位于加州，而排放最高的地区则位于德克萨斯州和俄克拉荷马州。排放与土地利用监管之间存在显著的负相关关系。通过限制新开发项目，全国最清洁的地区反而可能将新开发项目推向排放较高的地方。城市的排放普遍显著低于郊区，且这一城郊差距在纽约等老城区尤为突出。

title: The housing market effects of discrete land use regulations: Evidence from the California coastal boundary zone
Towards a System of Open Cities in China: Home Prices, FDI Flows and Air Quality in 35 Major Cities
Green Market Geography: The Spatial Clustering of Hybrid Vehicles and LEED Registered Buildings
venue: The B.E. Journal of Economic Analysis & Policy
abstract: This paper uses zip code level data to investigate the spatial distribution of two major "green" products. Using data from California, we document where hybrid vehicles cluster within the state. Using data for the entire nation, we study where LEED registered buildings cluster. By creating a novel measure of community environmentalism based on revealed preference political data, we document that green products cluster in environmentalist communities.
abstract_zh: 本文使用邮政编码级别的数据，考察两类主要“绿色”产品的空间分布。利用加州的数据，我们记录了混合动力汽车在该州内的聚集位置。利用全国数据，我们研究了LEED认证建筑的聚集位置。通过基于显示性偏好政治数据构建一个关于社区环保主义的新指标，我们记录到绿色产品聚集于环保主义社区。

title: Regional Growth and Exposure to Nearby Coal Fired Power Plant Emissions
Understanding Spatial Variation in Tax Sheltering: The Role of Demographics, Ideology and Taxes
Urban Growth and Climate Change
abstract: Between 1950 and 2030, the share of the world's population that lives in cities is predicted to grow from 30% to 60%. This urbanization has consequences for the likelihood of climate change and for the social costs that climate change will impose on the world's quality of life. This paper examines how urbanization affects greenhouse gas production, and it studies how urbanites in the developed and developing world will adapt to the challenges posed by climate change.
abstract_zh: 1950年至2030年间，居住在城市的世界人口比例预计将从30%增至60%。这一城市化进程对气候变化的可能性以及气候变化将给世界生活质量带来的社会成本都有影响。本文考察城市化如何影响温室气体的产生，并研究发达国家和发展中国家的城市居民将如何应对气候变化带来的挑战。

Environmental Valuation Using Cross-City Hedonic Methods
venue: Environmental Valuation: Interregional and Intraregional Perspectives
abstract: Hedonics is a leading revealed preference method for valuing nonmarket local public goods such as environmental quality. Using hedonic methods, numerous cross-city studies have been conducted pricing all sorts of nonmarket environmental attributes ranging from air pollution, to open space, to earthquake risk. Rather than reviewing this enormous literature, this chapter focuses on identifying exciting potential future avenues for hedonic research.
abstract_zh: 特征价格法（hedonics）是对环境质量等非市场地方公共物品进行估值的一种领先的显示性偏好方法。利用特征价格法，大量跨城市研究对各类非市场环境属性进行了定价，涵盖空气污染、开放空间乃至地震风险等。本章不对这一庞大的文献进行综述，而是聚焦于确定特征价格研究未来令人振奋的潜在方向。

title: The Death Toll From Natural Disasters: The Role of Income, Geography and Institutions
abstract: Using a new data set on annual deaths from natural disasters in 48 nations from 1980 to 1999, this paper tests several hypotheses concerning disaster mitigation. While richer nations do not experience fewer natural disaster shocks than poorer nations, richer nations do suffer less death from disaster. Democracies and nations with higher quality institutions suffer less death from natural disaster. The results are relevant for judging the incidence of a Global Warming induced increased in the count of natural disaster shocks.
abstract_zh: 本文利用1980至1999年间48个国家的年度自然灾害死亡人数新数据集，检验了关于灾害减缓的若干假说。尽管较富裕国家遭受自然灾害冲击的次数并不比较贫穷国家少，但较富裕国家因灾害死亡的人数更少。民主国家以及制度质量较高的国家，因自然灾害死亡的人数也更少。这些结果与判断全球变暖导致的自然灾害冲击次数增加的影响相关。

title: The Effects of Urban Rail Transit Expansion: Evidence from Sixteen Cities from 1970 to 2000
Changes in the Value of Life 1940-1980
Domestic Pollution Havens: Evidence From Cancer Deaths in Border Counties
abstract: Despite the concerns of many environmentalists, there is little evidence that global trade has led to the growth of pollution havens in poorer nations. Domestic pollution havens are a substitute for international pollution havens. Domestic pollution havens are likely to arise because environmental and labor regulations are not uniformly imposed across the United States. Using a new panel data set on county cancer death rates, this paper documents that cancer death rates have grown at specific state borders that have not imposed stringent labor regulation while cancer rates are falling at the Mexico border and are rising at the Canadian border.
abstract_zh: 尽管许多环保人士有所担忧，但几乎没有证据表明全球贸易导致了贫穷国家污染避难所的增长。国内污染避难所是国际污染避难所的替代。由于环境和劳动监管在美国各地执行不统一，国内污染避难所很可能形成。利用一套新的县级癌症死亡率面板数据，本文记录到：在未实施严格劳动监管的特定州界处，癌症死亡率有所上升，而在墨西哥边境癌症死亡率下降，在加拿大边境则有所上升。

title: Testing for Pollution Havens Inside and Outside of Regional Trading Blocs
abstract: This paper examines the composition of bilateral manufacturing trade in terms of its pollution intensity. A growing share of world trade takes place between nations who are members of the same regional trade agreement (RTA). We analyze how the formation of RTAs affects the composition of trade. We focus on whether richer or poorer nations specialize in exporting dirty goods. Using bilateral trade data over the years 1980 to 1997 for 128 nations for 34 manufacturing industries, we document that low-, middle-, and high-income nations differ with respect to their income elasticity in exporting dirty goods. Outside of RTA blocs, we find general support for the pollution haven hypothesis. As a nations income rises, its exports of dirty goods decrease relative to its exports of clean goods. When we compare, low-income, middle-income and high-income nations, we find that middle-income nations have the largest dirty trade income elasticity. Participation in a RTA slightly weakens the pollution haven effect observed outside of regional trading blocs. We also document cross-RTA heterogeneity in the composition of trade across 13 major RTAs in our sample.
abstract_zh: 本文考察双边制造业贸易在污染强度方面的构成。世界贸易中越来越大的份额发生在同一区域贸易协定（RTA）成员国之间。我们分析了RTA的形成如何影响贸易结构。我们关注较富裕或较贫穷的国家是否专门出口肮脏产品。利用1980至1997年间128个国家、34个制造业行业的双边贸易数据，我们记录到低收入、中等收入和高收入国家在出口肮脏产品的收入弹性方面存在差异。在区域贸易集团之外，我们发现总体上支持污染避难所假说。随着一国收入上升，其肮脏产品出口相对于清洁产品出口会下降。比较低收入、中等收入和高收入国家，我们发现中等收入国家的肮脏贸易收入弹性最大。加入RTA会略微削弱区域贸易集团之外所观察到的污染避难所效应。我们还记录了样本中13个主要RTA之间在贸易构成上的跨协定异质性。

title: Civic Engagement in Heterogeneous Communities
Cowards and Heroes: Group Loyalty in the American Civil War
New Evidence on Eastern Europe's Pollution Progress
venue: Topics in Economic Analysis and Policy
abstract: Under communism, Eastern Europe's cities were significantly more polluted than their Western European counterparts. An unintended consequence of communism's decline is to improve urban environmental quality. This paper uses several new data sets to measure these gains. National level data are used to document the extent of convergence across nations in sulfur dioxide and carbon dioxide emissions. Based on a panel data set from the Czech Republic, Hungary and Poland, ambient sulfur dioxide levels have fallen both because of composition and technique effects. The incidence of this local public good improvement is analyzed.
abstract_zh: 在共产主义时期，东欧城市的污染程度显著高于西欧城市。共产主义衰落的一个意外后果，是改善了城市环境质量。本文使用多组新数据来衡量这些改善。利用国家层面数据，我们记录了各国在二氧化硫和二氧化碳排放上的趋同程度。基于捷克、匈牙利和波兰的面板数据，环境中二氧化硫浓度的下降既源于构成效应，也源于技术效应。本文分析了这种地方公共物品改善的分配情况。

title: The Geography of U.S Pollution Intensive Trade: Evidence from 1958-1994
Two Measures of Progress in Adapting to Climate Change
Understanding the Decline in American Social Capital 1952-1998
Demographic Change and the Demand for Environmental Regulation
venue: Journal of Policy Analysis and Management
abstract: Demographic change can influence environmental policy if the demand for environmental regulation varies across demographic groups. For example, educational attainment is rising. If the more educated support greater environmental protection, then this trend predicts increased environmental support. This paper uses four separate data sets to document differences across demographic groups with respect to environmental support. Using the regression estimates, demographics based changes in environmentalism are predicted.
abstract_zh: 如果不同人口群体对环境监管的需求存在差异，那么人口结构变化就能影响环境政策。例如，受教育程度正在上升。如果受教育程度较高的人群更支持加强环境保护，那么这一趋势就预示着环保支持度的提升。本文利用四组独立的数据集，记录了不同人口群体在环保支持度上的差异。利用回归估计结果，我们预测了基于人口结构变化而产生的环保主义变化。

Smog Reduction's Impact on California County Growth
abstract: Over the last twenty years, environmental regulation has sharply reduced pollution levels in the Los Angeles region. Population growth has soared in the Los Angeles suburbs that have experienced the largest pollution reductions. This paper posits that regulation has increased local quality of life which has encouraged in‐migration. I explore alternative explanations for this growth.
abstract_zh: 过去二十年间，环境监管大幅降低了洛杉矶地区的污染水平。污染削减幅度最大的洛杉矶郊区，人口增长迅猛。本文认为，监管提高了当地的生活质量，从而吸引了迁入人口。本文探讨了对这一增长的其他解释。

title: The Effects of New Public Projects to Expand Urban Rail Transit
The Environmental Impact of Suburbanization
venue: Journal of Policy Analysis and Management
abstract: The U.S. population is increasingly spreading out, moving to the suburbs, and migrating from the Rust Belt to the Sun Belt. This paper uses recent household-level data sets to study some of the environmental consequences of population suburbanization. It measures the increase in household driving, home fuel consumption, and land consumption brought about by population dispersion. Suburban households drive 31 percent more than their urban counterparts, and western households drive 35 percent more miles than northeastern households. Despite increased vehicle dependence, local air quality has not been degraded in sprawling areas, thanks to emissions controls. Technological innovation can mitigate the environmental consequences of resource-intensive suburbanization. © 2000 by the Association for Public Policy Analysis and Management.
abstract_zh: 美国人口正日益向外扩散，迁往郊区，并从铁锈地带迁往阳光地带。本文利用近期的家庭层面数据集，研究人口郊区化的一些环境后果。文章测量了人口分散所带来的家庭驾车、家庭燃料消耗和土地消耗的增加。郊区家庭的驾车里程比城市家庭多31%，西部家庭的驾车里程比东北部家庭多35%。尽管车辆依赖性有所增强，但得益于排放控制，扩散地区的当地空气质量并未恶化。技术创新可以减轻资源密集型郊区化的环境后果。© 2000 公共政策分析与管理协会版权所有。

title: Climate Consumption and Climate Pricing from 1940-1990
abstract: This paper studies trends in US climate consumption and climate compensating differentials. Three findings emerge. First, the population has shifted so that the consumption of warmer winter climate has risen for both working families and more dramatically for senior citizens. Second, there has been a rise in rental capitalization. Third, earnings capitalization has declined. Between 1960 and 1990, the relative price of climate has increased for senior citizens and fallen for working families.
abstract_zh: 本文研究美国气候消费与气候补偿性工资差异的变化趋势。研究发现三点。第一，人口结构发生变化，工薪家庭和老年人对温暖冬季气候的消费均有所上升，其中老年人的增幅更为显著。第二，租金资本化程度有所提高。第三，收入资本化程度有所下降。1960年至1990年间，老年人面临的气候相对价格上升，而工薪家庭面临的气候相对价格下降。

abstract: Particulates are one indicator of air quality. This paper estimates particulate production functions to study how particulates co-move with manufacturing activity. I study whether more regulated counties enjoy less pollution per unit of economic activity and whether particulate regulation displaces economic growth to less regulated areas.
abstract_zh: 颗粒物是空气质量的一项指标。本文估计颗粒物生产函数，以研究颗粒物排放如何与制造业活动同步变化。本文考察监管更严格的县是否在单位经济活动中的污染更少，以及颗粒物监管是否会将经济增长转移至监管较宽松的地区。

title: Evidence on the Benefits of Vehicle Emissions Testing
New Evidence on Trends in Vehicle Emissions
abstract: Aggregate vehicle emissions have fallen even though total miles driven have increased. This article uses two new cross-sectional databases to study vehicle emissions profiles. I find evidence of large differences in vehicle emissions across model years, makes, and sizes. These findings are relevant for evaluating the benefits of previous regulatory efforts and for predicting the benefits of further vehicle regulation.
abstract_zh: 尽管机动车总行驶里程有所增加，但机动车排放总量已经下降。本文利用两个新的横截面数据库研究机动车排放特征。研究发现，不同车型年份、品牌和车身尺寸的机动车排放存在显著差异。这些发现有助于评估以往监管措施的效益，并预测进一步机动车监管的效益。
